integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Close-up of a young Chinese woman's face on a dilapidated rural earthen kang bed at night. Her eyes suddenly snap open, pupils contracting in the dim firelight. Push In slowly on her face. She gasps for air, eyes darting. <d>[Chinese]这……这是哪里？</d> says a young woman in a hoarse, confused voice.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to her hand reaching up to touch her own cheek, fingers trembling. Static Shot, camera holds steady on her hand.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to her eyes darting left and right, taking in the cracked mud wall and thatched roof above. Push In on her eyes as recognition dawns.

overall_soundscape: Dim rural interior at night, distant faint rooster crowing, crackle of dying embers in the stove.

non_diegetic_music: Low sustained strings slowly building, creating a disorienting rebirth atmosphere.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Medium shot over the woman's shoulder, looking at two tiny children huddled on the edge of the kang bed. The little girl is crying loudly, tears streaming down her thin face. Static Shot, camera holds. <d>[Chinese]妈……饿……</d> says a toddler girl in a wailing, hungry voice.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.500, the camera cuts to the three-year-old boy gripping his sister's hand, his own mouth trembling but trying not to cry. Push In slowly on the boy's determined little face. <d>[Chinese]妹妹不哭……哥哥去找吃的……</d> says a three-year-old boy in a small, trembling voice.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.500, the camera cuts back to the young woman's face as she stares at the children, her expression shifting from confusion to heartbreak. Static Shot.

overall_soundscape: A toddler girl's suppressed crying, the soft sound of a three-year-old boy's voice comforting her, fabric rustling on the kang.

non_diegetic_music: Strings fade to a quiet piano note, emphasizing the mother's heartbreak.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of the window — dawn light beginning to show through the cracked paper. Push In slowly on the window. <d>[Chinese]天要亮了。新的一天，新的开始。</d> says the young woman softly.
